c-gating-rule-never-locks-out.2.evidence: Public+Open space: Logged In+Read is now a no-effect rule (UI toast 'Access rule added, but it changes nothing. This space is Public with an Open join policy...' with standing warning), so the runbook's literal toast text does not apply there.
